# Longchamp

> > Longchamp is a French luxury leather goods house specializing in handbags, luggage, and accessories, featuring iconic collections like Le Pliage, Le Roseau, and Le Foulonné.

Founded in 1948, Longchamp combines Parisian elegance with artisanal craftsmanship at its Segré workshop. The brand emphasizes sustainability through recycled canvas collections and offers a wide range of leather goods including crossbody bags, totes, backpacks, and business accessories in premium calfskin and cowhide leather.
